stem: The function \(f\) is linear, its graph has a positive slope, and \(f(f(x)) = 9x - 8\) for all values of \(x\). What is the value of \(f(0)\)?
solution: Write \(f(x) = ax + b\). Then \(f(f(x)) = a(ax + b) + b = a^{2}x + ab + b\).
Matching coefficients: \(a^{2} = 9\), so \(a = 3\) (the slope is positive), and \(ab + b = 4b = -8\), so \(b = -2\).
verify:
x, a, b = symbols('x a b')
f = lambda v: a*v + b
s = solve(Poly(expand(f(f(x)) - (9*x - 8)), x).coeffs(), [a, b], dict=True)
pos = [d for d in s if d[a] > 0]
assert len(pos) == 1
assert [Rational(v) for v in spr_answers] == [pos[0][b]] == [-2]
